jobs.title: CV for Future Opportunities
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A little bit about us:

We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data – as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 150 people, our team currently represents 26 nationalities and we have offices in São Paulo, Mexico City, and Barcelona – while a large portion of us works remotely.

We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.

Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.

You can read more about our company here and about our team and culture here. Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work.

About the team:

  • We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack. 

  • Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.  

  • We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback. 

  • We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.

  • While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up for at least 3 hours per day.

  • Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.

Our perks:

🚀 Stock options (we are all owners and this is very important to us)

📈 Annual company bonus

🔆 Flexible working hours

🔝 Remote friendly

🐶 Pet friendly

🧘🏾‍♀️ Access to mental health service

👩🏻‍⚕️ Health Insurance

🎊 Paid time off on your birthday

🌎 Work from any office

💻 Renew your laptop every 3 years

🙋 Training Budget

😎 Team building events

🙀 Bank…

Your opportunity:



Our Payments product in Mexico has been growing at an incredible pace over the past few years. This product pillar’s mission is to enable companies in Mexico to access Variable Recurring Payments (VRP) through Account-to-Account (A2A) rails. This solves a critical need in the country, where thousands of businesses still struggle to collect recurring payments from their users in a scalable and automated way.



Our customers are any businesses that need to collect recurring payments — from loan repayments and subscriptions to utility bills. We provide them access to Direct Debit in Mexico (Domiciliación Bancaria) through an advanced API-based product that allows them to manage consents, orchestrate collections intelligently, and optimize their operations. The result: lower payment processing costs, fewer operational headaches, and smoother customer experiences.



This product demands not only strong technical expertise, but also an operations-first mindset to continuously improve scalability, reliability, and efficiency as we grow.



Your opportunity:

 - Lead one of the company’s most successful product lines — the Payments vertical in Mexico.

 - Manage and mentor the operations team, ensuring task efficiency through automation, engineering solutions, and data-driven process improvement.

 - Collaborate closely with providers and clients to identify and define new business opportunities.

 - Drive new product initiatives from ideation to production: build MVPs, validate hypotheses, and scale what works.

The challenge



The Intelligence Squad is Belvo's AI enabler team. One part of the squad builds the platforms and patterns that let every team at Belvo ship AI. This role sits in the other part: turning the financial data and payments we aggregate across Latin America into models that make real decisions, who looks creditworthy, which transaction is fraudulent, what category a payment belongs to, whether an income statement checks out. That data drives real financial outcomes for the people and businesses on the other end, so the bar for rigor is high.

You'll be the data science reference in the squad. We're not hiring someone to execute a modeling backlog someone else wrote. We want someone who decides which problems are worth modeling, defines how we know a model is good enough, and raises the data science bar for everyone they work with. You'll be deep enough in statistics and ML to defend a modeling choice to anyone, whether this is a set of rules to simplify a problem or a complex model that you build. You'll be close enough to the business to turn a commercial problem into a modeling roadmap and a business case. And you'll be a strong enough engineer to take your models from notebook to production and own them there.



Responsibilities



 - Model development and selection: Lead the design of statistical and ML models (classification, regression, ranking, NLP or LLM-based) for problems like risk scoring, fraud detection and transaction categorization. Choose approaches on their merits and defend those choices with data, not habit.
